title: Ed25519 declarations in wp11_soft_key.h not guarded by HAVE_ED25519
description: wp11_soft_key_new_ed25519() and wp11_soft_key_test_export_ed25519_pub() are declared unconditionally in wp11_soft_key.h. wolfCrypt only compiles Ed25519 support when HAVE_ED25519 is defined. The RSA-PSS functions in the same header are correctly guarded with #ifdef WC_RSA_PSS. Without the guard, building against a wolfCrypt without HAVE_ED25519 produces linker errors.
